correctness.rationale: Dinucleotide circular ambiguity is a directed closed walk; hence circular code iff its arc digraph is acyclic. Arc-reversing fixed-point-free complement gives symmetric source/sink elimination and an invariant topological order. The nine complement-orbits of unordered pairs each allow 3 states; all 3^9=19683 assignments can be exhaustively checked, with 48 complement-preserving relabelings. Independent complete brute-force acyclicity enumeration reproduced all coefficients F and all 48-group orbit coefficients G, totals 8383 labeled and 220 orbits, with 48 maximal labeled codes. Distinguishes complete finite search from an infinite classification; no inference for larger alphabets.
residual_risks: An unindexed enumeration of all six-letter reverse-complement circular codes could predate this result.

value.rationale: The first complementary alphabet with three paired symbols supplies a natural exact finite census of all circular dinucleotide codes, not merely maxima. Complete cardinality coefficients, symmetry orbits and 220 constructive representatives form a reusable coding-theory benchmark without claims about biology or higher alphabets.
